releaseNotes: Adds a PDF to a poster or talk: attach it in the poster or talk sheet, and a paperclip shows on the poster in the grant's Posters & Talks card. Version 1.7.1 fixed Vitae opening twice after turning on iCloud sync. Version 1.7.0 added iCloud sync between your Macs, a Vitae Plus feature that is off until you turn it on in Settings, Backups. It syncs your library through your private iCloud, with private fields encrypted. Mail, snapshots, preferences and attached files stay on each Mac, and PDFs sync only if you turn on Sync PDFs. Version 1.6.1 added a View on Altmetric link to each paper that has a DOI, PubMed ID or arXiv ID. Version 1.6.0 added posters and talks linked to grants.
